T: Bush tucker meets the big smoke.
D: A legendary bushman from the Top End takes on New York.
P: Pour a beer when Mick first sees a bidet in the hotel.
S: Scored belly skin dried overnight, salted hard and roasted until it puffs, cut into shards
Score pork belly skin, dry uncovered in the fridge overnight, salt heavily, roast at 240C for 30 minutes then 180C for 40 until it puffs and crackles. Cut into shards.
King prawns in garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers over the coals
King prawns marinated in garlic, chilli, lemon zest and oil, skewered and grilled hot for 90 seconds a side, lemon myrtle butter brushed on at the end.
Street cart hot dogs with sauerkraut
Frankfurts in soft rolls with mustard, sauerkraut and fried onion, off the cart.

Fry 2 sliced onions in 1 tbsp oil for 15 minutes until soft and golden. Simmer 8 frankfurts in hot water for 6 minutes, or grill until browned. Warm 8 soft hot dog rolls and fill with a frankfurt, onion, 200g drained sauerkraut and yellow mustard, with extra mustard and tomato sauce to pass around.
M: Crisp-skin barra, grilled. Stay clear of the billabong.

Barra fillets, skin scored and grilled crisp, flipped for a minute, brought out with a big knife. Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.
Seared rump on toasted white bread with beetroot, a fried egg and the lot
Thin rump seared hard, on toasted white bread with caramelised onion, a fried egg, beetroot, tomato, lettuce, cheese and barbecue sauce.
W: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base, with a warm berry sauce.

Crush 250g plain sweet biscuits with 100g melted butter and press into a 22cm springform tin. Beat 750g cream cheese with 180g sugar, then beat in 3 eggs one at a time, 200g sour cream, 1 tsp vanilla and the juice of half a lemon until smooth. Pour over the base and bake at 160C for 55 minutes until set with a slight wobble, then turn off the oven and cool inside for 30 minutes. Chill at least 3 hours. Simmer 300g frozen berries with 2 tbsp sugar for 6 minutes and spoon over each slice.
K: Walkabout Creek rum and ginger beer
Dark rum and ginger beer over ice

Dark rum poured over ice and spicy ginger beer with plenty of fresh lime, in a tall frosty glass. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice. Squeeze 15ml lime juice into each and add 150ml chilled ginger beer. Slowly pour 45ml dark rum over the back of a spoon so it floats on top. Add a lime wedge and stir at the table.

s.note: King prawns in garlic, chilli and lemon, grilled hot on skewers over the coals
s.how: Toss 600g peeled king prawns with 3 crushed garlic cloves, 1 chopped chilli, lemon zest and 2 tbsp oil. Thread onto skewers and grill hot for 90 seconds a side. Brush with 50g butter melted with 1 tsp lemon myrtle and serve with lemon.

s.n: Street cart hot dogs with sauerkraut
s.note: Frankfurts in soft rolls with mustard, sauerkraut and fried onion, off the cart.
s.how: Cook 500g beef mince with 1 onion, 2 tbsp Worcestershire, 2 tbsp tomato sauce and 250ml stock, thicken and cool. Line patty tins with 2 sheets shortcrust, fill, top with 2 sheets puff and bake at 200C for 20 minutes.

m.note: Crisp-skin barra, grilled. Stay clear of the billabong.
m.how: Score the skin of 4 barramundi fillets and pat very dry. Grill skin down over high heat until crisp, about 4 minutes, then flip for 1 minute. Melt 80g butter with 2 garlic cloves and 1 tsp lemon myrtle and spoon over.

w.note: Baked cheesecake on a biscuit base, with a warm berry sauce.
w.how: Cut a 500g butter sponge into 16 squares. Whisk 400g icing sugar, 40g cocoa, 20g melted butter and 150ml milk into a thin icing. Dip each square, drain and roll in 200g desiccated coconut. Set on a rack for an hour.
